Molecular dynamics simulation based analysis of celecoxib-polymer interactions
This dataset contains scripts and coordinate files for running and analysing molecular dynamics simulations to investigate celecoxib-polymer interactions in aqueous solution.  Trajectory files (stripped of water and ions) are included.
The associated study is described in:
" Comparative analysis of drug-salt-polymer interactions by experiment and molecular simulation improves biopharmaceutical performance", Sumit Mukesh, Goutam Mukherjee, Ridhima Singh, Nathan Steenbuck, Carolina Demidova, Prachi Joshi, Abhay T. Sangamwar, Rebecca C. Wade, submitted.
